stories.title: Google expands Gemini 4 Argon access with background tasks and introductory API pricing
stories.summary:
Google expanded Gemini 4 Argon to Gemini app Pro and Ultra subscribers on October 13, alongside a tasks mode that can continue working after the user leaves the computer.[16] SiliconANGLE reports that the paid Gemini API is also opening to developers worldwide, with introductory prices of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 on November 30.[16] The app supports more than 40 connected services, while Google Antigravity brings its coding interface into the macOS Gemini app; tasks remain limited to selected countries and the Pro rollout is still in progress.[16] For implementation teams, the practical questions are which connectors and regions a client can actually use, how unattended actions will be approved, and whether an application remains economical after introductory pricing ends.

Sources:
[16] https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/13/gemini-4-argon-reaches-gemini-app-pro-and-ultra-subscribers-alongside-a-new-tasks-mode

stories.title: HCLTech and Anthropic pair enterprise AI implementation with sandboxing and human oversight
stories.summary:
HCLTech announced a Global Premier Partnership with Anthropic on October 12, planning a dedicated business unit and Centre of Excellence to build enterprise solutions using Claude, Cowork and Claude Code.[32][30] Its services scope includes secure deployment sandboxes, forward-deployed engineers, workforce training and integration into existing operations, rather than only reselling model access.[32] HCLTech also plans to integrate Claude into its AI Force platform for IT support, code remediation and digital employee services, with policy guardrails, exception handling and human oversight for high-impact changes.[32][30] The announcement provides no engagement prices, named customer deployment results or measured savings, so it establishes a delivery partnership rather than proven return on investment.[32] For smaller services firms, the relevant pattern is to combine a narrowly scoped implementation with governance, training and a clear operational handoff.

Sources:
[30] https://english.punjabkesari.com/business/hcltech-anthropic-partner-to-scale-governed-agentic-ai-across-enterprises
[32] https://www.hcltech.com/en-us/press-releases/hcltech-and-anthropic-sign-global-premier-partnership-scale-governed-agentic-ai
